title: Visual Identity
slide_intent: Use a distinct chapter opening to separate the visual toolkit from the verbal guidance, helping readers keep the kinds of guidance apart.
strategic_value: The repeated display style can make visual identity feel part of one Burger King document.
demonstration: A large Visual Identity title sits on a flat field with small running labels and notices.
practical_value: Use this divider to identify where visual identity guidance begins without interpreting it as a standalone application rule.

content_islands.name: Chapter title
content_islands.spec: Place the oversized Visual Identity title at upper left, orange on brown, leaving an open field below.

content_islands.name: Navigation and notices
content_islands.spec: Retain the small top navigation, page number and bottom publication notice.

reference_purposes.Expression: The Visual Identity divider uses large rounded display type and the warm orange on brown treatment.
